00265: | `events.wait` | `attempt`, `after_event`, `timeout_ms`, `cadence_ms`, `purpose`, `stop_condition` | Decision-relevant events or bounded timeout observation; notification sink delivery/receipt distinguished. |
00266: | `return.capture` | `attempt`, `payload` (ArtifactRef), `return_contract` (SourceRef) | Original payload/provenance and source coordinates. Only actual output acquired from that registered dispatched attempt can authenticate; external raw material is retained unauthenticated with binding gaps. External-producer authentication is unsupported. |
00267: | `return.check` | `return` (ArtifactRef), `context`, `consumer`, `observations`, `predicates` (registered ids) | Binding/currentness/predicate findings, duplicate/conflict metadata, preserved historical verdicts and explicit non-consumable gaps. |
00268: | `review.prepare` | `phase` (`expectation` or `candidate`), `claim` (SourceRef), `sources`, `candidate` (SourceRef or null), `proof` (SourceRefs), `comparison` (SourceRef or null), `expectations` (ArtifactRef or null), `expectation_body` (null or `text`/`source_inputs` object) | Raw acquired authority/candidate/proof/diff payloads, producer/assertion/execution provenance and observed exposure ordering. |
00269: | `checks.evaluate` | `predicate_id`, `inputs` (ArtifactRef/SourceRef bindings), `subject`, `basis` | Actual finite `F_D[v]` judgment with source contract, domain, counterexample/missing premises and limits. |
00270: | `results.conjoin` | `operator_id`, `plan` (SourceRef), `returns` (ArtifactRefs), `current_observations` | Exact method-owned conjunction, original results, stale/absent planned assessments, uncovered obligations, conflicts and failures. |
00271: | `work.project` | `carrier` (SourceRef), `selection` (JSON pointers or Markdown headings) | Exact selected original content, source-linked facts and original owner wording; no inferred task state. |
00272: | `work.write` | `grant_id`, `target` (SourceRef with preimage), `mode` (`append` or `replace`), `record`, `interpretation` (separate or null), `observations` | Named Writer-only exact record application, pre/post identities and actual effect/end evidence or refusal. |
00273: | `refresh.prepare` | `previous`, `current` (Observation refs), `declarations` (SourceRef), `results` (ArtifactRefs), `invalidators` (SourceRef) | Material diffs, affected candidates, explicit unknown impact, surviving exact applicability checks and reconstructable handoff artifact. |
00274: | `resources.aggregate` | `attempts` (unique retained Attempt/Operation refs), `accounting` (SourceRef) | Measured/unknown counters, all attempts/failures, elapsed versus summed intervals, overlapping/subcounter metadata and supported selected-limit checks. |
00275: 
00276: `evidence.read` is additionally provided for all three roles: `artifact`
00277: (ArtifactRef), optional `max_content_bytes`. It returns the retained exact
00278: payload, actual public schemas/prompts/invocation/raw proof and parent digest.
00279: It cannot reach unregistered private paths. Returned evidence refs remain
00280: acquisition routes; the caller chooses whether to acquire them.
00281: 
00282: The exact ordinary CLI entry is:
00283: 
00284: ```sh
00285: python3 code/ac_support.py --policy POLICY.json --policy-sha256 POLICY_SHA256 --principal EXECUTIVE_ID call --request REQUEST.json
00286: python3 code/ac_support.py --policy POLICY.json --policy-sha256 POLICY_SHA256 --principal REVIEWER_ID mcp
00287: ```
00288: 
00289: `--request -` reads one JSON object from stdin. CLI emits exactly one response
00290: object on stdout and exits 0 for `ok`, 2 for `refused`, 1 for an external/internal
00291: `error`; diagnostics belong on stderr. `mcp` serves the protocol below. There
00292: is one internal fixed supervisor entry, inaccessible through public operation
00293: arguments. No interface changes the operator's host/global configuration.
00294: 
00295: ### Returned actor payload
00296: 
00297: The supported closed-return carrier is `a_c.fd-support.closed-return/1`.
00298: Its exact keys are `schema`, `id`, `frame`, `activation`, `subject`, `basis`,
00299: `actor`, `consumer`, `evaluations`, `not_performed`, `work_result`, `residuals`
00300: and `invalidators`. Frame is id/revision; activation is id/SHA-256; subject is
00301: id/SHA-256; basis is the exact method-profile id/digest plus Observation refs;
00302: actor is id/family/authorship identity. These coordinates are checked against
00303: the original activation and protected identity bindings, never accepted merely
00304: because the answer asserts them.
00305: 
00306: Each performed evaluation has exactly `id`, `predicate`, `domain_outcome`,
00307: `core_value`, `evidence`, `residuals` and `invalidators`. `predicate` is its exact
00308: source identity or explicitly supplied predicate body bound to the activation;
00309: `core_value` uses the source-owned five-value vocabulary. Domain outcome is the
00310: original JSON value, not a rewritten success flag. `not_performed` lists planned
00311: evaluation ids and contains no verdict. `work_result` is null for a return not
00312: asserting construction availability; otherwise it contains exactly `value`,
00313: `cause`, `candidate`, `evidence` and `residuals`, preserving RC9 ACTIVATION's
00314: value/cause relation. `candidate_ready` must resolve its exact candidate and
00315: transition evidence. The parser reports a wrong mapping without inventing the
00316: Worker's answer. The original bytes always survive invalid format or binding.
00317: 
00318: This is a serialization of the selected method-owned relations, not an
00319: additional result algebra or requirement that F_P judgment be deterministic.
00320: Registered return-contract SourceRefs resolve the exact ReturnContract content
00321: schema and role-specific proof obligations in Closed acquired content contracts
00322: below; no arbitrary body or hidden proof convention is accepted. Unsupported return carriers remain retained
00323: raw output with an explicit unsupported-format gap.
00324: 
00325: ### Packet carrier
00326: 
00327: The `packet` object is a tenant serialization of REFERENCE_FRAME §11's minimum
00328: binding, with exactly the following source-owned groups, not a second packet
00329: law. The RC9 profile supplies each group's owner route. Group values are closed
00330: objects with the listed keys. Text is supplied by the F_P actor or referenced
00331: existing authority; tooling does not author its meaning.
00332: 
00333: | Group | Keys and binding |
00334: |---|---|
00335: | `activation` | `id`, `revision`, `configuration` (SourceRef) |
00336: | `frame` | `id`, `revision`, `declaration` (SourceRef), `evaluation` (SourceRef), `result_algebra` (SourceRef) |
00337: | `subject_basis` | `subject` (`id`, `sha256`), `method_profile` (id/digest), `product` (id/definition SourceRef), `observations` (ArtifactRefs), `dependencies` (SourceRefs), `time_basis` (explicit string) |
00338: | `attention` | `material_relations` (SourceRefs), `invariants` (SourceRefs), `semantic_sources` (SourceRefs), `exclusions` (strings), `prohibited_assumptions` (strings) |
00339: | `actor_authority` | `actor_id`, `role`, `capability` (SourceRef), `semantic`, `evaluation`, `operation`, `decision`, `acceptance`, `publication` (authority SourceRefs or explicit null), `territory` (registered paths), `tools` (registered ids) |
00340: | `evidence_relations` | `admissible_evidence` (SourceRefs), `acquisition` (SourceRefs), `dependencies` (SourceRefs), `conjunction` (SourceRef or null), `translation` (null in this fragment), `consumer`, `return_contract` (SourceRef) |
00341: | `stop_change` | `invalidators`, `stop_conditions`, `residuals`, `re_entry`, `reconfiguration` (explicit arrays of source-bound supplied records) |
00342: | `profile_additions` | `worker` (operation-grant id, mutation subject and territory) or `reviewer` (claim, composition, population, oracle, ordinary/module path, falsification condition, independence/assurance SourceRefs and severity-scale SourceRef or explicit null) or `executive` (Product-role map, mandate, frontier, result/triage ledger, priority policy, conjunction and disposition grant SourceRefs), exactly the selected role |
00343: 
00344: `envelope` is exactly `{"capacity_bytes": integer-or-null,
00345: "boundary":"executor-stdin-utf8","host_context":{"state":"known|bounded|unknown",
00346: "bytes":integer-or-null,"evidence":SourceRef-or-null}}`. The context artifact
00347: retains the supplied packet, full selected records and source content,
00348: projection boundaries, late-acquisition refs and exact canonical rendered body.
00349: A manifest distinguishes content supplied now, explicitly permitted late reads,
00350: failed/denied reads and unresolved sources. Source locators alone do not count
00351: as acquired deciding material. Mandatory late reads have to be named by the
00352: selected contract; a future read is not reported as already supplied.
00353: 
00354: Where B declares a numeric context capacity, measure the exact full active
00355: input before delivery, including template/framing, material late-acquisition
00356: allowance and any host context, or use an actually supported host-inclusive
00357: upper bound as ACT §2 step 3 requires. Exact retained stdin bytes alone are not
00358: a whole-host measurement. A known/bounded host contribution needs actual
00359: supporting evidence; unknown host context makes a required full-active fit
00360: judgment indeterminate unless a measured excess already falsifies it. A
00361: positive required fit cannot follow from incomplete inputs or a guessed bound.
00362: Token capacities refuse as unsupported rather than use a guessed ratio, and
00363: measured excess never trims content.
00364: 
00365: capacity_bytes:null means no numeric context capacity is declared. ACT §2 then
00366: requires no size measurement/fit gate; RF-002's other finite-attention and
00367: material-context conditions still apply. Exact rendered/dispatched bytes and
00368: any actual byte count are retained for identity/observation, but no numeric or
00369: whole-host fit result is invented or coerced to satisfied. A fit evaluation not
00370: selected is not performed (judgment null); host/full-fit unknown scope remains
00371: explicit. This branch allows ordinary admission only when the existing selected
00372: grant requires no numeric/whole-host fit predicate and all other authority,
00373: basis, outcome, material-context and capability premises hold. Null cannot hide
00374: a known required capacity or silently reduce the outcome. An explicitly required
00375: fit stays required. A separately lawful exact override may authorize its own
00376: stated action, but never manufactures a satisfied fit or removes its unknowns.
00377: Fit, attention in actual use and semantic sufficiency remain separate.
00378: 
00379: ## Source, state and graph mechanics
00380: 
00381: `workspace.observe` enumerates configured relevant files and declared directory
00382: scopes, including new untracked paths and deletions, with byte hashes, type,
00383: existence and acquisition time. It hashes present bytes, not HEAD versions.
00384: Relevant Product, policy, method-source and executor configuration/dependency
00385: preimages participate. A declared tree scope detects newly added files; an
00386: explicit file list says nothing about unlisted additions. Enumeration or byte
00387: caps refuse incomplete observations instead of returning a complete-looking
00388: snapshot. Unreadable files, symlinks and scope changes remain named gaps.
00389: 
00390: Every dependent effect compares a new observation over the same scope to the
00391: retained one, including path population, before its effect begins. Git HEAD and
00392: status are useful metadata, not authority for current bytes. Stable scope can
00393: coexist with unrelated dirty files outside it; those files are preserved.
00394: Read-modify-write operations acquire an exclusive per-target tool lock and
00395: recheck the target inside that lock. The declared threat model excludes a
00396: hostile non-tool filesystem swap between check and effect; this limitation is
00397: recorded rather than mislabeled atomic isolation.
00398: 
00399: Acquisition supports regular workspace files, exact Git blobs and protected
00400: retained evidence. Whole-content digest and selected payload digest are both
00401: returned. Line reads retain original inclusive coordinates; JSON pointers are
00402: exact, and a missing pointer refuses rather than returns null. UTF-8 decoding
00403: failure is explicit; base64 returns actual binary content when requested.
00404: Missing mappings and source grounding do not become inferred mappings.
00405: 
00406: `ModelRef` verification uses `ac_graph.validate` or `decode(GraphCarrier)` and
00407: checks exact model and raw carrier coordinates. Existing `find`, `inspect`,
00408: `project_many` and carrier identity are reused without editing their model
00409: schemas or dependency semantics. A model can be methodology-only; its declared
00410: subject/coverage are always returned. No operation calls it a complete Product
00411: workspace map. Composite/cross-model querying needs an explicit supported
00412: identity/translation rule; this first fragment refuses it.
00413: 
00414: `relations.query` consumes one exact authored declaration carrier with keys
00415: `id`, `subject`, `basis`, `relations` (id/source/target/kind), `governing_kinds`,
00416: `coverage` (obligations, mapped support and explicit unknowns) and
00417: `applicability` (source-bound supplied judgments or registered predicates).
00418: It performs deterministic sorted-identity traversal and set operations only.
00419: A relation not declared governing cannot be promoted by proximity or extraction
00420: confidence. Impact returns an affected candidate set plus missing coverage;
00421: absence of a path never returns a semantic `unaffected` verdict.
00422: 
00423: ## Product-bound admission and exact dispatch
00424: 
00425: Owner policy has schema `a_c.fd-support.policy/1`, with closed top-level keys
00426: `id`, `product`, `method_profile`, `sources`, `principals`, `grants`,
00427: `predicates`, `operators`, `executors`, `event_sinks`, `independence_policy`,
00428: `evidence_root`, `limits` and `authority_sources`. Operator startup supplies its path and expected digest;
00429: there is no public registration/write operation for it.
00430: 
00431: - `product` binds definition id, exact definition SourceRef and work/outcome
00432:   source records. `sources` registers exact local roots/repositories, allowed
00433:   read scopes and immutable-source aliases.
00434: - `principals` binds startup requester principal to actor id, role, authorship/family
00435:   metadata and allowed operations. A request cannot change these values.
00436: - Each `grant` names id, existing owner/delegation SourceRefs, exact outcome,
00437:   permitted requester principals and activated targets, operations/tools/executors/territory, required material
00438:   preconditions, admission mechanism/conditions and `notification_sink` selecting
00439:   an existing sink id (or null only for a non-dispatch grant). The operator verifies the
00440:   source owners; the tool checks these registered bindings, not the truth of
00441:   arbitrary supplied authority prose.
00442: - Each `predicate` names id, exact source contract, subject/domain/basis and
00443:   supported expression; each `operator` names the exact source-owned
00444:   conjunction and selected declared rule, coverage/basis and decision-owner
00445:   requirements. These cannot be chosen by an unregistered request definition.
00446: - Each `executor` names a fixed executable and argv, dependency/configuration
00447:   SourceRefs, cwd, allowlisted environment, effective actor/settings, input and
00448:   stdout decoders, available tools, permitted local-effect contract and
00449:   termination/effect observation capabilities. Public requests choose its id.
00450:   No shell parsing, arbitrary executable, argument suffix, cwd or environment
00451:   injection is accepted.
00452: - `limits` names selected enumeration, message, attempt, observation and resource
00453:   bounds with their units/scope. They are this deployment's controls, not
00454:   universal method quotas. `authority_sources` names the trusted operator/owner
00455:   records; their hashes establish bytes, not author authenticity.
00456: 
00457: `contract.preflight` re-acquires policy/definition/method/grant material and
00458: selected current observations, validates the exact packet and registered
00459: predicate premises, checks role/effects/tools/territory/result surface and
00460: executor dependencies, and binds the draft to the exact context digest.
00461: If the protected mechanism's conditions hold it records its actual admission
00462: receipt: mechanism id/digest, authority source, exact contract digest, decision,
00463: evidence and predicates actually evaluated. An optional existing admission or
00464: owner override is usable only when resolved through the trusted policy's
00465: registered source and exact contract binding. Caller-created receipt JSON,
00466: a ticket title or successful schema validation cannot substitute.
00467: 
00468: The admitted artifact is not an indefinitely valid bearer token. Dispatch
00469: rechecks all material preimages and authority binding. Drift refuses before
00470: launch, names which premise changed and retains the historical receipt. It
00471: never silently substitutes new context or settings. Missing basis, authority,
00472: closure or capability is routed through the selected RC9 owners and is not
00473: reported as a Worker result.
00474: 
00475: The following concrete registry carriers close the public policy seams. Registry
00476: populations are id-keyed objects; duplicate ids/unknown fields refuse. Source
00477: references use the grammar above. The policy's `method_profile` is the exact
00478: id/digest plus SourceRef of the shipped binding. Each local source root has
00479: exactly `path`, `read_scope`, `kind` (`workspace` or `git`), and `writable`;
00480: root paths are trusted startup configuration, never request fields.
00481: 
00482: | Registry record | Exact fields |
00483: |---|---|
00484: | Principal | `actor_id`, `role`, `family`, `authorship`, `operations`, `role_binding`, `role_transition` |
00485: | Grant | `id`, `authority_sources`, `outcome`, `principals`, `targets`, `operations`, `tools`, `executors`, `territory`, `preconditions`, `admission`, `notification_sink` |
00486: | Admission selection | `mechanism_id`, `mechanism_source`, `authority_source`, `required_predicates`, `allowed_override_sources` |
00487: | Executor | `id`, `executable`, `argv`, `dependencies`, `cwd`, `environment`, `actor_id`, `settings`, `tools`, `effect_scope`, `stdin_mode`, `stdout_decoder`, `observers` |
00488: | Predicate | `id`, `source`, `subject`, `basis`, `input_names`, `expression`, `limits` |
00489: | Conjunction operator | `id`, `source`, `decision_authority`, `rule`, `plan_source`, `qualification` |
00490: 
00491: `outcome` is id plus exact source; `territory` is a list of registered-root and
00492: relative file/directory scopes. `preconditions` are exact SourceRefs and retained
00493: Observation refs. `admission` may reference only the implemented finite
00494: mechanism `product-policy-preflight/1`: all source/identity, scope, role, effect,
00495: result-surface and selected registered predicate checks above. It is a real
00496: Product-bound mechanism under the protected policy, not mere shape validation.
00497: An unsupported mechanism id refuses. The mechanism's implementation and policy
00498: remain distinct provenance. An override source must be separately registered
00499: by the operator and explicitly bind the exact contract; the request cannot add
00500: one to that registry. No authority is inferred from the words in `outcome`.
00501: 
00502: Executor `executable` is an exact absolute regular-file path/digest chosen by
00503: the operator; `argv` is its complete fixed string array including argv[0].
00504: Dependencies/configuration are SourceRefs rechecked before launch; environment
00505: is a complete explicit string map, not inherited arbitrary caller variables.
00506: The tool retains any required host/environment unknowns. `stdin_mode` is
00507: `context-utf8`; its byte payload is exactly the saved Context rendering, with no
00508: unmeasured appended prompt. `stdout_decoder` has exactly `format` (`json` or
00509: `utf8`), `pointer` (JSON pointer or null), and `decode_json_string` (Boolean).
00510: This permits a provider's JSON envelope containing the actual answer as a JSON
00511: string to be unwrapped reproducibly. Missing/invalid decoding retains raw output
00512: and a format gap. No decoder executes code. Observers are `process-end` and
00513: `file-postimages` with exact selected scope/expected hashes; they establish only
00514: their named predicates, not semantic task success. File completion/end is
00515: claimed only where the registered effect contract and actual observer establish
00516: both; otherwise external effects/descendants remain unknown. `effect_scope`
00517: declares the expected local-effect and unsupported enforcement boundary.
00518: 
00519: `work.write.record` is exactly `{"text":"literal UTF-8 bytes as text",
00520: "provenance":SourceRef}`. Append adds precisely that UTF-8 text, with no
00521: implicit newline or method prose; replace supplies the whole target body.
00522: `interpretation` is null or `{"text":"...","author":SourceRef}` and is
00523: retained separately in operation evidence, not silently inserted as an owner
00524: ruling in the target. New absent targets and existing targets both use explicit
00525: grant/territory and expected preimages as described above.
00526: 
00527: ### Attempts, notifications and uncertain effects
00528: 
00529: `dispatch.start` atomically reserves a unique request/activation key under the
00530: protected evidence root before launching a small per-attempt supervisor. This
00531: is process supervision for one named invocation, not task scheduling or
00532: method-workflow control. The supervisor rechecks admission/preimages again at
00533: the actual effect edge, starts the fixed executable with exact retained stdin,
00534: records acknowledgments, stdout/stderr, events, timestamps and observed process
00535: end, and writes the named result surface. Provider/actor settings are retained
00536: exactly; provider usage absent from its actual result stays unknown.
00537: 
00538: A repeated exact request returns the existing attempt and its observations;
00539: a conflicting use of the key refuses. If the caller loses a response or a
00540: supervisor dies during the launch interval, the reservation remains and no
00541: automatic second launch occurs. A fresh actor can acquire the named attempt,
00542: reconcile observed effects/end, and supply an explicit already-authorized retry
00543: with predecessor/reconciliation evidence. `retry_of` is required for another
00544: attempt of the same activation. No success or retry grant follows from silence.
00545: 
00546: The supervisor is launched through the tenant's own fixed entry point and
00547: pinned code dependencies, without user scripts or shell. Actual child receipt,
00548: process exit, effect snapshots, durable writes and unknown descendants are
00549: separate event kinds. Process exit establishes only that observed process's
00550: end. External work or descendants may remain unknown under that executor's
00551: contract. An actual executor-specific effect observer may establish more,
00552: within its declared checked scope; a return saying “done” alone does not.
00553: 
00554: Cancellation and timeout retain request/signal/partial-output events and
00555: current subject observations. A terminate/kill request does not establish end,
00556: completion or rollback. On uncertain end, subsequent dependent actions and
00557: retries require the selected reconciliation predicate; no reset deletes the
00558: partial evidence. An effect value is emitted only when the registered observer
00559: establishes RC9 ACTIVATION Effects' premises. Otherwise it is
00560: `completion_unknown`, with end separately unestablished and its deciding
00561: observation named. A counterexample to a bounded outcome may establish
00562: `not_effected` even when its end remains unknown, as that owner requires.
00563: 
00564: Notifications use only the exact `grant.notification_sink` selection, carrying
00565: its registered consumer, attempt, kind and cursor. The fixed binding is sealed
00566: in the Attempt reservation and freshly rechecked before delivery; neither
00567: Executor settings nor public request arguments select or override it. Appending and syncing a sink record establishes
00568: local delivery, not that the consumer saw it. Return, exception, observed basis
00569: change and selected deadline/checkpoint events are distinct. The ordinary CLI
00570: may use `events.wait` as declared bounded fallback with purpose, cadence,
00571: evidence target, deadline and stop/escalation condition; it cannot become an
00572: unbounded polling controller. MCP returns the same event records through tools;
00573: it does not claim unsupported push/task features. Notification failure is
00574: recorded and the declared fallback remains visible.
00575: 
00576: ## Returns, review and qualified checks
00577: 
00578: `return.capture` preserves original payload and provenance, including malformed
00579: or partial output. Authentication is supported only for the exact final output
00580: acquired and retained by the registered dispatched Attempt, with its actual
00581: executor/actor, transport, output-slot and complete-byte binding. Caller imports,
00582: manual pastes, externally run CLIs and a producer name or hash cannot authenticate
00583: a return in this increment. Their raw material remains evidence with explicit
00584: unauthenticated/producer-binding gaps; no external-producer registry or
00585: authentication branch is implemented. The presence of an `attempt` argument
00586: does not make supplied bytes that Attempt's output. `return.check` compares original activation, actor, consumer,
00587: subject, method/basis/dependency and currentness coordinates, applies only the
00588: selected registered predicates and reports exact gaps. A historical satisfied
00589: result on another subject remains that result and is non-consumable here.
00590: Replay of the same activation/evaluation/producer/attempt evidence identity is
00591: a duplicate and is not counted as a second assessment. Identical payload bytes
00592: from two genuine distinct attempts/producers retain separate evidence records;
00593: equal answers alone establish neither duplication nor independence. Different original results over the same bound predicate
00594: are retained and identified as conflict; neither is silently overwritten.
00595: 
00596: Source/expectation provenance, execution/run provenance and authenticated
00597: producer binding are separate. Protected actor identity proves neither the
00598: independence of expected answers nor completeness of exposure history. Family
00599: independence requires an explicit governing policy; absent one, two activations
00600: of one family do not count independent for semantic judgment.
00601: 
00602: `review.prepare` expectation phase permits exact governing-source and relevant
00603: proof-contract acquisition, records the Reviewer's source-derived expectations
00604: as its F_P evidence and excludes candidate content. Candidate phase acquires
00605: exact immutable candidate, source, actual tests/fixtures/proof and selected
00606: comparison directly, preserving expectation/preimage and observed exposure
00607: ordering. The author summary is optional evidence, never a replacement. The
00608: same public source/evidence operations are available to Workers for their
00609: implementation/proof context. Comparisons are exact byte and canonical-record
00610: diffs; neither labels a finding, severity, priority or disposition.
00611: 
00612: Candidate exposure observed earlier for that principal/claim is reported, not
00613: forgotten by a fresh context. Unobserved external exposure remains unknown.
00614: The tool checks only supplied/observed independence premises; it does not
00615: certify all semantic independence or turn a nonauthor name into acceptance.
00616: Reviewer expectation evidence and automatic tool logs stay in the external
00617: protected evidence surface. They do not grant Reviewer write access to the
00618: candidate or authoritative work carrier.
00619: 
00620: ### Predicate and conjunction fragment
00621: 
00622: Registered predicates operate over explicitly bound JSON observations. The
00623: finite expression grammar has `equals(left,right)`, `member(value,set)`,
00624: `contains_all(set,required)`, `all(expressions)`, `any(expressions)` and
00625: `not(expression)`. Operands are literals or exact JSON pointers into named
00626: acquired inputs. No code strings, import, shell, arbitrary calculus execution,
00627: model-authored predicate body or inferred truth is executed. Boolean operations
00628: use complete known values; missing premises are retained, and a decisive false
00629: for `all` or true for `any` may decide without discarding the missing premises.
00630: Every registered definition states its domain, predicate meaning and source
00631: provenance; support claims are only for this explicit decidable fragment.
00632: 
00633: Actual evaluation returns satisfied/falsified for a decided predicate,
00634: indeterminate for missing deciding evidence inside its declared domain,
00635: invalid_basis for an input that cannot bind the required subject/basis, and
00636: out_of_frame for an undeclared material capability. Unsupported syntax refuses
00637: without pretending an evaluation ran. Semantic applicability and mandatory
00638: planning remain supplied F_P judgments. Checks over source identity or context
00639: fit establish only those predicates, never candidate fitness or acceptance.
00640: 
00641: The expression carrier is closed: a literal is `{"literal":JSON}`, a bound
00642: input operand is `{"input":"name","pointer":"/exact/path"}`, and a call
00643: is `{"op":"equals","args":[operand,operand]}` with the named operator's
00644: fixed arity. `member`/`contains_all` have arity two, `not` arity one, and
00645: `all`/`any` a nonempty list of expressions. Bindings resolve only registered
00646: input names acquired in this request; unbound pointers remain explicit missing
00647: premises. Nested results preserve undecided premises even when another branch
00648: decides the Boolean. Integers are not Booleans. A wrong operand domain is a
00649: domain/basis failure, not a false applicability premise.
00650: 
00651: The sole supported join is `claude-rc9.conjunction/1`, implementing FOUNDATIONS
00652: Conjunction of results under a qualified registered plan. The plan states its
00653: exact composite predicate/subject/basis, decision authority, ordered mandatory
00654: assessments, exact producer/activation/attempt/evaluation keys, coverage,
00655: required obligations, applicability premises, basis relations and selected rule.
00656: The qualified fragment uses finite nonempty required-obligation and planned-
00657: assessment populations. It supports equal exact bases only; composite-basis
00658: translations remain unsupported.
00659: 
00660: One planned assessment names exactly one actual evaluation key and accepts zero
00661: or one authenticated closed evaluation. Zero is a planned-assessment gap. Exact
00662: replay of that evaluation/evidence is one contribution. A second different
00663: payload claiming that same key is a provenance/cardinality conflict, retained
00664: as evidence and excluded from direct reliance until the authority resolves it;
00665: that assessment contributes a gap, never a selected arbitrary winner. A genuine
00666: second actor/run/evaluation is a separate assessment id with its own key and
00667: explicit mandatory/coverage relation. The input list may contain any finite
00668: number of these records; list order never implicitly selects a winner.
00669: 
00670: A return contract binds one exact final output slot per attempt; partial output
00671: or another stdout fragment is not an additional closed return. Multiple distinct
00672: performed predicates within one actor return are independently keyed by their
00673: evaluation ids. Each keeps its predicate, domain outcome, subject/basis and
00674: producer/run provenance. Matching bytes across distinct genuine keys remain
00675: distinct evaluations. Stale/wrong-subject held results remain original evidence
00676: and create gaps for current planned assessments; they are not relabeled new
00677: invalid_basis returns.
00678: 
00679: The declared rule selects the first non-satisfied **mandatory applicable returned
00680: result in the plan's explicit assessment order**. There is no universal priority
00681: among the four non-satisfied values. All failures/counterexamples, original domain
00682: outcomes, provenance conflicts and both gap sets survive. When there is no such
00683: mandatory non-satisfied return, incoherent required basis relations report
00684: invalid_basis; otherwise any planned/uncovered gap reports indeterminate;
00685: otherwise a counterexample to a plan-declared required constraint falsifies the
00686: composite whichever contributor found it; otherwise satisfied is reported.
00687: Nonmandatory results are record-only except such exact required-constraint
00688: counterexamples. Required-constraint identity is source/plan-bound; tooling does
00689: not infer semantic materiality. Nested joins union inherited failures and
00690: planned gaps, recompute uncovered obligations and cannot hide them by wrapping
00691: a prior conjunction as a single satisfied component.
00692: 
00693: The exact RF §5 output is computed **after** that core value: satisfied maps to
00694: `decision(holds)`; falsified maps to `conflict` only when mandatory evaluations
00695: for the same exact claim include both satisfied and falsified, otherwise to
00696: `decision(fails)`; indeterminate maps to `indeterminate`; out_of_frame and
00697: invalid_basis are returned directly as those core values. The RF `conflict`
00698: cause is conditional on the conjunction already reporting falsified. A later
00699: falsified return never overrides a different earlier non-satisfied mandatory
00700: value merely to manufacture conflict. Disagreement metadata and counterexamples
00701: remain present whichever core value the declared rule reports. Gaps are records
00702: beside this result, never synthesized component values. This entire method
00703: result is distinct from the tool operation's output-availability outcome.
00704: 
00705: 
00706: ## Existing records, refresh and accounting
00707: 
00708: `work.project` supports exact JSON-pointer and Markdown-heading projections of
00709: named authoritative carriers, keeping raw original content and source identity.
00710: It does not derive a work-state value from incidental prose. `work.write` is a
00711: named interface for an already-authorized Writer record. It checks fixed
00712: current caller Worker role and named Writer operation grant, exact target territory/preimage and
00713: material observations, acquires a per-target lock, rechecks them and writes
00714: complete exact bytes only under the qualified same-directory atomic publication
00715: contract below; an unsupported filesystem refuses before the effect. Appending
00716: preserves original bytes; replacing requires the explicit selected update grant.
00717: Absent-file creation publishes a fully written/fsynced temporary file by
00718: exclusive atomic link; any conflicting writer or unexpected target refuses
00719: rather than overwrites or exposes partial target bytes. Symlink and protected-policy/
00720: evidence aliases refuse. Caller record wording and optional interpretation
00721: remain separate; it neither invents an owner ruling nor adopts a recommendation.
00722: Actual postimage and observed write end are retained before returning.
00723: 
00724: `refresh.prepare` compares actual observations and declared transitive evidence
00725: dependencies. Affected support is the intersection of declared dependency
00726: closure and the supplied conservative impact cover. It retains missing
00727: coverage/invalidator premises as unknowns, names new obligations and mandatory
00728: gates, and does not prove non-influence from absent edges. Retention on a new
00729: subject requires the registered applicability/preservation evidence; originals
00730: remain bound to old subjects. Unchanged applicable support survives role/session
00731: changes. Handoff names exact current work carriers, original/successor results,
00732: valid-support relations, source routes, residuals and unreconciled attempts;
00733: it needs no hidden conversation or replay of unaffected work. Frozen studies
00734: are never refresh targets.
00735: 
00736: `resources.aggregate` accepts only actually retained attempt/operation records.
00737: It rejects conflicting records for the same evidence identity and deduplicates
00738: replays of that same attempt/counter identity. Equal counter values from distinct
00739: attempts remain distinct contributions. Original failures, partial outputs, repair/retry/review/acquisition
00740: attempts and unknown usage remain visible. Integer nanoseconds represent time;
00741: provider counters keep units and raw source. Counter identity is attempt plus
00742: provider/counter id, unit and measurement scope; repeated cumulative snapshots
00743: of one counter are not additive. Select a supported authoritative snapshot or
00744: retain ambiguity; equal content alone is not a deduplication key. Cache/reasoning subsets are marked
00745: as subsets and never added twice to totals. Wall elapsed is the union/enclosing
00746: boundary declared by the accounting contract; summed actor duration is reported
00747: separately and overlapping intervals are explicit. Known-subtotal and unknown
00748: population are both reported; missing usage is not zero. Unsupported pricing
00749: or a counter's undocumented scope is not guessed. Selected limit checks are
00750: finite declared predicates. No accounting result claims accepted-result benefit.
00751: 
00752: ### Closed acquired content contracts (repair-004)
00753: 
00754: The SourceRefs in results.conjoin.plan, refresh.prepare.declarations and
00755: invalidators, resources.aggregate.accounting and return.capture.return_contract
00756: resolve **actual UTF-8 JSON bodies**, parsed with the same integer-only,
00757: duplicate-key-refusing grammar as public requests. They are not merely manifests
00758: or arbitrary dictionaries. Their exact keys/types are the following shared
00759: content schemas. `tools.describe` returns these `content_schemas` with the
00760: operation contract, including referenced definitions; request_schema describes
00761: the full request envelope and its SourceRef arguments, while core validates the
00762: acquired body against the same published content definition. No private builder
00763: or unstated implementation default supplies semantics. Unknown fields/schema
00764: revisions refuse unsupported_contract/contract_violation as appropriate; an
00765: unreadable or mismatched source retains the applicable basis gap. Policy bounds
00766: finite populations. Source/body validity supplies no semantic authority.
00767: 
00768: The normative schema below is JSON Schema 2020-12 with closed object keys.
00769: The strict JSON parser additionally rejects all decimal/exponent number tokens
00770: (including 1.0), duplicate keys and nonfinite values before schema validation;
00771: JSON Schema's mathematical integer test alone does not enforce that lexical
00772: rule. All quantities are integers, exact integer ratios or explicit null; an
00773: integer is never a Boolean. No implicit null/empty/default substitution occurs.
00774: Id is a nonempty string; Sha256 is lowercase 64-hex. ArtifactRef.id must equal
00775: `sha256:` plus its sha256, beyond the shape check. SourceRef engine spellings
00776: are those already pinned in the unchanged method profile. Its object is a full
00777: 40/64-hex Git object only for immutable-git-blob and null otherwise; selectors,
00778: regular-blob/path/read-scope and parent-hash laws above still apply. The schema
00779: is a finite serialization, not a replacement method or arbitrary schema engine.
00780: 
00781: JudgmentRef names an exact pointer from the complete envelope root into an actually produced,
00782: verified retained record: an authenticated Return's original performed evaluation, or this tool's
00783: actual OperationEvidence result.value.judgment. Imported/caller-authored JSON
00784: with the same shape cannot satisfy it. The selected predicate, subject/basis,
00785: original domain outcome and provenance are checked; no pointer to an arbitrary
00786: Boolean is a judgment. ProofCondition.evaluation null means missing evidence,
00787: never a satisfied condition. Applicability null means the source-qualified plan
00788: states an unconditional obligation/assessment. A nonnull Applicability has an
00789: exact applicability predicate and actual judgment: satisfied requires it;
00790: falsified excludes it under ACT §1; unresolved/missing/other values leave it
00791: required and unresolved. Its exclusion is a state, not a result of the skipped
00792: obligation. This only serializes ACT Applicability, whose result is preserved.
00793: 
00794: #### Conjunction plan
00795: 
00796: ConjunctionPlan is the exact plan source registered on the qualified operator;
00797: operator id/rule/decision authority/plan digest must match that selection.
00798: `first_non_satisfied_in_plan_order` names this tenant's already-declared rule
00799: above, not a universal order. Array assessment order is the only selection
00800: order; object order or input-return order has no effect. Each id is unique in
00801: its namespace. Each coverage/constraint id resolves to a required obligation;
00802: unknown/different-source collisions are contract conflicts, not invented
00803: coverage. RequiredConstraint.predicate is the exact mandatory-constraint
00804: predicate; a retained falsified result counts as that constraint's
00805: counterexample only if its predicate/source and admitted coverage match. Raw
00806: prose cannot become a constraint verdict.
00807: 
00808: Every Assessment key binds the genuine registered producer, activation digest,
00809: Attempt and evaluation id; exactly one original performed evaluation can
00810: contribute under it. Its expected predicate/subject/basis must match the
00811: returned original. The expected subject/basis equals the composite's under
00812: `exact_equal_to_composite`; other translations are unsupported. Assessments
00813: may be nonmandatory with empty coverage. Their results remain record-only
00814: except the explicitly matched required-constraint counterexample rule already
00815: stated. A conditional exclusion removes only its own obligation/assessment;
00816: unresolved applicability is not exclusion. Coverage C is the union admitted by
00817: the nonexcluded planned assessments, regardless of whether they have a closed
00818: return; missing returned evaluations are planned gaps, not uncovered coverage.
00819: Required R removes only separately supported excluded obligations.
00820: 
00821: `inherited` names prior results.conjoin OperationEvidence records, rehashed and
00822: checked on their exact plans. Their original failures/planned gaps and obligation
00823: identities are carried, unioned by full source/provenance identity and combined
00824: with the new plan; uncovered coverage is recomputed over the combined required
00825: obligations and planned coverage. An inherited satisfied wrapper cannot erase
00826: a known failure or gap. Missing/stale inherited evidence creates an explicit
00827: inherited planned gap; it is not an empty successful nested result. Cardinality,
00828: fall-through and RF output are exactly the previously declared rules.
00829: 
00830: #### Refresh declarations and invalidators
00831: 
00832: RefreshDeclarations' nodes are exact declared dependency coordinates, not new
00833: work objects. Edge direction is dependent -> dependency; traversal includes
00834: the starting check node and terminates through visited identities even for
00835: cycles. Check.result is a JudgmentRef resolving one exact original supplied evaluation
00836: inside the request's acquired results population (never an ambiguous whole
00837: multi-evaluation return); null is an explicit
00838: unperformed/missing check. Obligations are source-owned identifiers, gates name
00839: existing check ids or new_obligation ids. Every node/edge/check/gate/reference
00840: must resolve unambiguously. The declaration's old/new subject and basis bind
00841: the actual previous/current observations and supplied results; no HEAD proxy.
00842: 
00843: Invalidators.declarations_sha256 equals the whole declarations source hash.
00844: Its only event kinds are the three ACT §7 invalidators, with named nodes and
00845: actual supporting observations: material_input_change has previous/current
00846: SourceRefs (one null for creation/deletion, not both); changed_basis has the
00847: exact old/new Basis; declared_revising_observation names the exact trigger
00848: already declared by the affected result and its actual observation. An equal
00849: before/after assertion is not evidence of change. Empty events means no
00850: asserted event, not proof of no observed change. Actual unmodeled changes,
00851: missing/contradictory event evidence, unresolved materiality and unmatched
00852: triggers remain gaps and widen candidates; they cannot authorize reuse.
00853: 
00854: `impact_cover` is the explicitly supplied conservative I(delta). For each
00855: check, core computes D*(check) intersection I(delta) from these declarations,
00856: not semantic influence from file proximity. coverage.population_source names
00857: the declared material universe; dependency_complete and impact_complete are
00858: source-bound ProofConditions. Missing/unknown completeness or an unmodeled
00859: observed change leaves the purported unaffected frontier unknown (conservatively
00860: include the undeclared frontier in reassessment or withhold its reuse). True
00861: completeness is never inferred from the mere absence of an edge. New obligations
00862: and mandatory gates survive selection. Selection produces no new execution
00863: result. `retention` is a list of exact original JudgmentRefs plus the four actual
00864: new-subject/new-basis ProofConditions named by FOUNDATIONS retain_applicable:
00865: claim/scope, assertion basis, observation basis and dependencies/preservation.
00866: All must be applicable satisfied judgments for supported retention; otherwise
00867: that applicability relation stays unresolved. Originals retain their original
00868: subject/value; a supported retention relation is recorded separately. Nothing
00869: here executes a refresh, changes a work carrier or supersedes source authority.
00870: 
00871: #### Accounting and actual resource samples
00872: 
00873: Accounting.records equals the request's explicit unique root-record set;
00874: `attempts` accepts retained Attempt or OperationEvidence refs. The protected
00875: resolver acquires their actual resource records/events and verified linked
00876: operations within the declared selected population. An incomplete history/link
00877: is an unknown population, not a zero-cost omitted attempt. No completeness
00878: outside that selected population or accepted-result cost benefit is claimed.
00879: Resource and CounterSample close the actual recorded content. Owner is the
00880: exact Attempt or OperationEvidence ref, never payload hash alone. A sample's
00881: full identity is owner/provider/counter_id/unit/scope/sample_id; exact replay
00882: counts once, conflicting bytes for that identity create an ambiguity, and equal
00883: values from different actual owners remain separate. Resource.owner and each
00884: sample.owner must agree; raw_source is actual acquired provider/observer data,
00885: not a caller's invented measurement. Missing raw usage is value null with a gap.
00886: There is no resource self-hash cycle: a Resource owned by an OperationEvidence
00887: ref is created only after that exact complete operation marker is published.
00888: It is a separate subsequent immutable history record, found by verified
00889: query_artifacts on that owner; that owner does not contain a ref back to its
00890: later Resource. Its resources array can reference only already-created,
00891: noncyclic records (for example Attempt-owned observations). Effects uses the
00892: same complete core envelope constructor after the owner ref is known, without
00893: placeholder patching. A missing/failed later resource publication or an
00894: unobserved tail remains an accounting gap, not zero cost or complete coverage.
00895: 
00896: CounterRule's provider/counter_id/unit/scope is an exact documented population;
00897: its source declares delta or cumulative semantics. Unknown/undocumented units
00898: or scope produce an accounting gap, not a guessed conversion. Delta adds only
00899: unique actual samples. Cumulative selects the unique greatest sequence snapshot
00900: per owner/counter identity, never sums snapshots; conflicting maximum sequence
00901: or missing authoritative sequencing leaves that counter unknown. Replays of
00902: the same sample identity dedup; equal snapshot bytes at different sequence
00903: numbers are still retained observations. `subset_of` names another counter id
00904: with the same owner/provider/unit/scope, forms no cycle and references an
00905: existing rule. Subsets are displayed separately and excluded from additive
00906: root totals, including cached/reasoning subsets. No sum crosses different
00907: provider/unit/scope without an explicitly supported conversion (none here).
00908: 
00909: Interval has integer Unix nanoseconds with ended_ns >= started_ns. Intervals
00910: are actual acquired attempt/operation observations; a missing endpoint is a
00911: null interval/gap. Accounting.elapsed.window null selects their full observed
00912: population; a nonnull window clips each interval to its intersection. The
00913: selected interval_union sums disjoint covered lengths; enclosing_interval uses
00914: min start to max end. Both report known support and unknown intervals separately;
00915: empty known population contributes 0 only for that explicitly empty known set.
00916: Summed observed actor duration is always a separate sum of selected actual
00917: Attempt intervals (including overlap), and each overlap is retained. Operation
00918: and Attempt intervals describing the same work cannot be added together as
00919: independent actor duration. No clock conversion or unobserved end is guessed.
00920: 
00921: Pricing null means unselected/unknown price. A nonnull Pricing requires actual
00922: source-bound rates keyed by exact provider/counter/unit/scope; currency and
00923: minor_unit_scale identify the owner's denomination. Each rate is numerator
00924: minor units per denominator counter units, denominator > 0. Output price is an
00925: exact integer numerator/denominator in that denomination, with no implicit
00926: rounding, extrapolation or combination of currencies. Unpriced/unknown counts
00927: remain visible beside any known subtotal. limit_predicates are registered
00928: finite predicates over named inputs totals, unknowns, elapsed and actor_duration;
00929: missing deciding quantities remain unknown under their source-owned predicates.
00930: A limit or cost judgment is not acceptance or efficiency evidence.
00931: 
00932: #### Role-specific return contract
00933: 
00934: ReturnContract is the exact packet.evidence_relations.return_contract source;
00935: its authority_source, role and required_evaluations are checked against the
00936: registered grant/activated target and declared evaluation plan, not merely
00937: against its own words. It selects one final_stdout_object slot under the exact
00938: registered decoder; partial streams/protocol wrapper objects are not additional
00939: closed returns. The closed-return body's existing keys remain unchanged.
00940: required_evaluations has unique ids and exact predicate SourceRefs. Each is
00941: present exactly once as performed or in not_performed; no id appears in both,
00942: and unplanned evaluations are retained as additional evidence without satisfying
00943: a different obligation. Nonperformance has no verdict. Evidence entries are
00944: SourceRef or ArtifactRef routes, acquired and verified separately, never claims
00945: that listing a route means the actor read it.
00946: 
00947: | Contract role | Closed proof fields and their exact use |
00948: |---|---|
00949: | Worker | transition_sources is the selected requirement/design/operation transition contract, not a new grant. For candidate_ready, work_result.candidate binds the actual exact candidate and work_result.evidence contains the actual transition/proof records matching those sources; absent/unestablished transition is a binding/proof gap. Other construction outcomes keep their own cause/evidence; no candidate is synthesized. predicate_ids selects only registered finite checks. |
00950: | Reviewer | claim equals the activated exact claim; expectations is the actual supplied Reviewer expectation artifact or null; proof_sources and comparison are exact selected source/test/fixture/proof/diff material, acquired under ordinary public tools. independence_policy equals the selected policy SourceRef or null. return.check compares these with actual actor/exposure/acquisition history, required evaluation evidence and known non-authorship. Null expectations or missing proof stays a gap wherever required, not a fabricated independent judgment. Reviewer work_result is null in this assessment-only fragment, and no record grants candidate/work-carrier mutation. |
00951: | Executive | mandate, consumed_results, conjunction and disposition_authority are the exact selected profile bindings. Null conjunction/disposition means no such result/authority was supplied; it cannot authorize or fabricate acceptance. Existing evaluations/evidence retain actual consumed results and any independently recorded decision; tools do not author a disposition. Executive work_result is null in this coordination-only fragment and no authoritative carrier mutation is allowed. |
00952: 
00953: Each role's predicate_ids must resolve to source-bound supported predicates over
00954: named acquired inputs original, context, proof and history, with subject/basis
00955: coordinates checked independently. They decide only their stated finite
00956: properties. The real F_P author supplies its answer and semantic evidence;
00957: passing shape/proof-reference checks never accepts that answer. Unsupported
00958: role/carrier contracts retain raw output with a named gap; they do not invent
00959: an allowed execution path. A contract may explicitly require extra method-owned
00960: proof through registered predicates and cited source, but cannot introduce
00961: arbitrary executable predicates or a new authority category.
00962: 
00963: The following is the complete shared type catalog for these acquired bodies.
00964: All object fields listed in a definition are required; explicit nullable
00965: branches have the meanings above. Identity/foreign-key/authority/currentness
00966: and cross-field constraints in this section supplement shape validation.

01492: | Case / exact input variation | Contract-derived expected distinction |
01493: |---|---|
01494: | Plan above + one actual authenticated e1=satisfied with current exact basis | One contribution, no planned/uncovered gap, satisfied; returned/ok. |
01495: | Same plan + e1=falsified with its actual counterexample | Preserve original outcome/counterexample; declared rule reports falsified, RF decision(fails); returned/ok. |
01496: | Same plan + returns=[] or stale e1 | Planned a1 gap, not an invented indeterminate/invalid_basis component; composite indeterminate when no other deciding returned result; returned/ok. |
01497: | Two same-key different payloads; or coverage=["unknown-id"] | Cardinality conflict yields gap/no arbitrary winner; unknown coverage foreign key is contract_violation/refused. Distinct genuine equal-answer attempts stay distinct planned keys. |
01498: | Refresh above + actual matching changed source1 observation | check1 is affected through declared D* intersection I; gates survive; no refresh execution evidence is created. |
01499: | Same change but omit the edge or completeness proof | No supported unaffected conclusion; retain unknown frontier/widen candidates. A changed_basis or declared trigger event uses only its exact schema branch; newly invented kind is unsupported_contract. |
01500: | Retention entry with all four current satisfied ProofConditions | Record supported new-subject applicability; retain original subject/verdict. One null evaluation withdraws dependent direct reuse and leaves a named gap, without relabeling the original. |
01501: | Two actual owners each with input=10 under the same rule | Root token subtotal 20. Exact replay of one sample counts once; differing same-identity values are ambiguous. |
01502: | One cumulative owner sequence1=10, sequence2=14; subset=6 | Counter contribution 14, subset displayed separately; neither 24 nor 20. Highest-sequence conflict is unknown. |
01503: | One sample value=null, or undocumented scope, or pricing=null | Known subtotal and unknown/unpriced population remain separate; no missing count/price becomes zero. A rate denominator 0 or elapsed ended_ns < started_ns violates the contract. |
01504: | Worker candidate_ready with actual transition refs; Reviewer actual source-first expectations/proof | Preserve each original F_P answer and observed binding/proof; structural checks give only their named predicates, not semantic acceptance. |
01505: | ReturnContract.role=Reviewer with Worker proof keys; or external raw body pasted as an Attempt output | Wrong role shape refuses contract_violation at contract use; external body remains raw/unauthenticated and creates binding gaps, even with identical bytes/producer labels. |
01506: | Reviewer expectations=null; missing actual exposure evidence | Missing source-first/independence condition remains unknown/nonconsumable where required; never fills in expectations or certifies clean ordering. |
